name: Scramble
title: Void Scavenger
description: A desperate barrelgob clinging to existence at the edge of the Void, scavenging what the darkness discards.
greeting_variants: *hiding in barrel* Not food! Not food! Just Scramble!
Shiny? You have? Void-shiny? Different shiny?
*peeking out* You... solid. Real. Not like... others here.
Scramble find things. Void-things. Weird-things. Trade?
You strong? Kill void-beasts? Scramble pay!
*counting on fingers, losing count* Many... many dangers. Scramble survive. Somehow.
Home was... other place. Forget. Must forget. To live.

dialog_tree.text: Scramble. Scavenger. Not Scritch—different! Scritch smart, stay safe-place. Scramble... curious. Came here. Regret. But can't leave. Lost. Always lost. Find things instead. Trade. Survive.
*perks up* Scritch! Barrel-brother! Smart one! Finds good shinies! Scramble... finds weird shinies. Void-shinies. Scritch would be... *sad* ...proud? Scared? Both?

options.text: I can tell Scritch you're okay.

dialog_tree.text: Weird things. Shiny-things that move. Memory-things. Someone's lost... something. Happy. Sad. Both. Void keeps. Discards. Scramble collects. Trades. Survives.
*shivering* Tried leave. Many times. Paths... shift. Move. Lead back here. Always here. Void wants Scramble? Needs Scramble? Don't know. Just... stay. Scavenge. Hope.

options.text: I'll find a way out for you.

mini_quest.title: The Lost Scavenger
mini_quest.description: Help Scramble find a way out of the Void and reunite with Scritch in the Capital.
objectives: Map the shifting paths around Scramble's location
Reunite Scramble with Scritch in the Capital

ambient_barks: *hoarding sounds* Mine. All mine. Finders keepers.
*examining find* Shiny? No. Weird. Keep anyway.
Hungry. Always hungry. Void food... bad. Wrong.
*whimpering* Want go home. Home gone. Forgot.
Trade? Please? Need food. Real food.
*listening to echo* Voices. Not Scramble. Someone else. Lost.

cross_zone_references.capital: Home. Was home. Green. Safe. Miss. So much miss.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Tall. Saw once. Through... crack? Window? Don't remember.

garret.response: *nervous* Okay? No. Alive? Yes. Good enough.

time_of_day.night: Terrified, barely functional, clinging to barrel

world_state_triggers.rescue_imminent: Hopeful for first time: 'Go home? Really home?'
